create_ImageAsset: create an ImageAsset instance with a named image like stop_sign or cherry_blossom
get_path_ImageAsset: get the s3 path for a named image asset with a given file extension
load_pil_image: load a PIL Image from a named image asset as a jpg file
load_image_embeds: load a torch.Tensor of image embeddings from a named image asset for llava 1.5 testing
read_image_bytes: read raw bytes of a named image asset with a given file extension
